Select activity_id, assay_chembl_id, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type, and molecule_chembl_id. Join activities with assays and molecule_dictionary. Filter where assays.tid equals 165 and activities.standard_type equals IC50. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by activity_id, assay_chembl_id, and molecule_chembl_id.
